---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A brief description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem or scenario this feature would address. Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this to work. Be as specific or high-level as you need.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought of, or workarounds you're currently using.

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or examples (e.g., similar features in ipmininet, FRR docs, etc.).
